aiVerification.summary: Draft is citeable but grouping and several extracted outcomes are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Changed factor is overbroad and misclassified as material/spec instead of magnetize jig/process.
Normal vs NEW JIG comparisons ignore date grouping; 9/15 uses the wrong Normal row and later dates lack same-date Normal control.
CM+CP, BP+SM, LONG SM, SHORT SM, and aggregated NEW JIG are mixed without subgroup keys.
Measurement-2 and measurement-3 are parser artifacts with invalid stats and header-only citations.
Gauss specs are present in source rows but not captured in subResults.
correctionPlan: Redefine changed factor as magnetize jig condition: Normal vs new magnetize jig, with CM+CP and BP+SM as subgroups where applicable.
Preserve date as a grouping key; only compare rows with a valid same-date or clearly stated baseline.
Separate defect rate, magnet broken check, gauss, and function/NG outcomes under the same jig validation context.
Remove parser-artifact measurement outcomes based only on SMG!41 or SMG!47.
Populate gauss spec values from each row and cite the relevant data rows plus headers.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but several are insufficient or misused for the claimed comparisons.
